sys_script_client.description: As an incident Manager, I want to ensure that when a user without the security_officer role creates or updates a confidential incident, They must specify someone in the "Assigned To" field before saving, So that the incident does not become invisible to the creator by accident.
sys_script_client.name: Make Assigned to * for confidential INC
